text:
The browser app acts as the
control-room shell: role-filtered
hub, specialist module routes,
dense workflows and a floating
Kelvin assistant.
textPreview: The browser app acts as the | control-room shell: role-filtered | hub, specialist module routes, | dense workflows and a floating | Kelvin assistant.

text:
The Expo app mirrors field work
with KPI strip, health watch,
module cards and secure
token-backed access for technicians
and supervisors.
textPreview: The Expo app mirrors field work | with KPI strip, health watch, | module cards and secure | token-backed access for technicians | and supervisors.

text:
Users authenticate once and move
across modules instead of
encountering isolated module logins
or disconnected experiences.
textPreview: Users authenticate once and move | across modules instead of | encountering isolated module logins | or disconnected experiences.

text: The stack is modern and split cleanly by responsibility
textPreview: The stack is modern and split cleanly by responsibility

text: Frontend, application, database and cognitive concerns are separated clearly enough that each tier can evolve without turning the system into a monolith.
textPreview: Frontend, application, database and cognitive concerns are separated clearly enough that each tier can evolve without turning the system into a monolith.

text:
Web uses React with Vite, React
Router, Ant Design and Tailwind.
Mobile uses Expo Router, React
Native 0.81.5 and React 19.1.
textPreview: Web uses React with Vite, React | Router, Ant Design and Tailwind. | Mobile uses Expo Router, React | Native 0.81.5 and React 19.1.

text:
Server uses Express, Prisma, JWT
auth, cron services and
module-oriented controllers over
PostgreSQL-backed operational data.
textPreview: Server uses Express, Prisma, JWT | auth, cron services and | module-oriented controllers over | PostgreSQL-backed operational data.

text:
Kelvin runs on FastAPI with RAG
hooks, local Ollama integration and
Gemma 4 model discovery, while
Docker composes the local platform.
textPreview: Kelvin runs on FastAPI with RAG | hooks, local Ollama integration and | Gemma 4 model discovery, while | Docker composes the local platform.

text: The architecture separates user experience, orchestration and intelligence cleanly
textPreview: The architecture separates user experience, orchestration and intelligence cleanly

text: The app behaves like one platform because routing, auth and data contracts remain centralized even though the runtimes are separated.
textPreview: The app behaves like one platform because routing, auth and data contracts remain centralized even though the runtimes are separated.

text:
Web and mobile provide
task-specific shells for planners,
engineers, supervisors and
technicians while preserving shared
navigation and auth logic.
textPreview: Web and mobile provide | task-specific shells for planners, | engineers, supervisors and | technicians while preserving shared | navigation and auth logic.

text:
Express route groups connect the UI
to module controllers for
procurement, work orders, manuals,
KPIs, inspections, contracts and
more.
textPreview: Express route groups connect the UI | to module controllers for | procurement, work orders, manuals, | KPIs, inspections, contracts and | more.

text:
Prisma maps a large shared schema
so modules can read and write the
same operational records instead of
fragmenting the plant data model.
textPreview: Prisma maps a large shared schema | so modules can read and write the | same operational records instead of | fragmenting the plant data model.

text: The codebase is organized by product domain first, framework second

text: That structure makes ownership understandable and supports modular growth, but it also exposes where refactoring and stronger testing discipline are needed.

text: From a code review perspective, the best part of the system is that it solves many real maintenance workflows without splintering into disconnected tools.

text:
Web, mobile, backend and AI
surfaces are already separated
cleanly enough that the system can
scale by adding modules rather than
rewriting foundations.

text:
The Prisma model count and route
breadth indicate one central
maintenance data backbone rather
than many isolated micro-apps.
textPreview: The Prisma model count and route | breadth indicate one central | maintenance data backbone rather | than many isolated micro-apps.

text:
Work orders, procurement, manuals,
KPIs, inspections, collaboration
and energy make the app feel like a
real plant operations platform, not
a demo shell.
textPreview: Work orders, procurement, manuals, | KPIs, inspections, collaboration | and energy make the app feel like a | real plant operations platform, not | a demo shell.

text: The main code review concerns are authorization, migrations and test coverage
textPreview: The main code review concerns are authorization, migrations and test coverage

text: The highest-signal risks are not visual polish. They are permission correctness, deployable schema evolution and the lack of automated regression coverage.
textPreview: The highest-signal risks are not visual polish. They are permission correctness, deployable schema evolution and the lack of automated regression coverage.

text:
The user permission API must keep
returning and updating
canCreateWorkOrder and
canCloseWorkOrder because the
manpower UI still depends on those
switches.
textPreview: The user permission API must keep | returning and updating | canCreateWorkOrder and | canCloseWorkOrder because the | manpower UI still depends on those | switches.

text:
Every new Prisma table needs a
checked-in migration because the
documented deploy flow relies on
prisma migrate deploy and will
otherwise fail at runtime.
textPreview: Every new Prisma table needs a | checked-in migration because the | documented deploy flow relies on | prisma migrate deploy and will | otherwise fail at runtime.

text:
Add canary tests, tighten API
typing, keep auth universal across
modules, and continue splitting the
largest screens and route handlers
into smaller units.
